answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 288 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the ledge challenge, the fable audit can replay the ridge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 27 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
